_about: SpecCheck demo document set. Each doc lists URLs in priority order; fetch_docs should try them in order and keep the first that returns a real PDF (starts with %PDF). Values under 'verified' were read from the document during research on 2026-10-05; re-check after download.

specs.verified: CPS control 07/01/2025. T rating must equal F rating; VOC below SCAQMD 1168; listed by FM, ITS or UL. (Cal Poly backup: T = F unless code exempts; VOC per CALGreen.)
CPS control 08/09/2024. CRI >= 80; L70 at 50,000 h; dims to 5%; 5-year warranty; DLC listed. (BCIT backup: efficacy >= 75 lm/W, no CRI rule.)

cases.title: Firestop sealant, through-penetrations

submittal.verified: STI SpecSeal LCI Intumescent Sealant, (c) 2025, rev ZSFOD5062 25171 (the PDS linked from STI's product page on 2026-10-05). VOC Content 26 g/L; ASTM E84 Class A; up to a 4-hour fire rating; ASTM E814 (UL1479), ASTM E1966 (UL2079), CAN/ULC-S115.

backup_case.note: If LCI turns out to have a newer sheet, use Hilti FS-ONE MAX instead.
backup_case.verified: FS-ONE MAX TDS dated 12/16; UL 723 flame 0 / smoke 10; CSFM 4485-1200:0108. No numeric VOC on this sheet.

cases.notes: Replaces the Hilti FS-ONE MAX case: Hilti media-canonical links 404 for scripts. LCI meets the CPS VOC and test-standard rules. Submits the current 2025 sheet: the 2020 copy on emisupply.com (rev ZSFOD5062 3409, same values) is superseded, which would make this clean control an approve-with-note.

cases.title: Firestop system, floor penetration

submittal.verified: 3M System C-AJ-2738 (floor). F Rating 2 hr, T Rating 0 hr. Penetrants: PVC Sch 40 up to 2 in, rigid PVC conduit up to 2 in, CPVC SDR 13.5 up to 2 in, PEX SDR 9 up to 1 in.

backup_case.verified: STI W-L-1079 (wall). F 1 and 2 hr, T 0 hr. Metallic pipe only.

cases.notes: Fails the CPS rule T = F (T 0 vs F 2). Note: under a spec like UCSF, which needs T only at floors, this would be judged differently; the spec decides.

cases.title: Firestop sealant, cable penetrations

submittal.verified: 3M Fire Barrier Sealant IC 15WB+, (c) 2005, doc 98-0400-5077-9. VOC 0; flame spread 0 / smoke 0; continuous operating temp not to exceed 120 F.

cases.compare_verified: Rev B: VOC <2 g/L; flame spread 5 / smoke 50; service temp -20 to 180 F; up to 3 hr; adds CAN/ULC-S115.
cases.notes: Cleanest real old-vs-current pair in the set: VOC, flame/smoke and temperature all changed.

cases.title: Firestop system, steel pipe through gypsum wall

submittal.verified: Hilti W-L-2078. F 1 or 2 hr; T 0, 1 or 2 hr. Plastic pipe only: PVC and CPVC up to 10 in, ABS and FRPP up to 6 in, PVDF and PEX up to 4 in. No insulation.

cases.conditions: Drawings show steel pipe at this wall (case condition penetrant_types contains 'steel pipe').

backup_case.note: If the Hilti host blocks scripts, use STI W-L-1079 (metal pipe only) and change the planted condition to 'PVC pipe'. W-L-1079 also has T 0 hr, so it would fail T = F too.

cases.notes: T can be read as 0 for some ratings; the answer key requires the validity problem and allows a spec problem as well.

decoy.note: Same host has an OLD BLT sheet (Rev. 07/01/19, 40L 31.69 W / 128.23 LPW). Useful as an extra out-of-date case.
